name: SetIpuMpeg1Mode
evidence: sets or clears bit 23 of the IPU's control register 0x10002010, the MPEG-1 mode, as the sequence header says

name: WaitIpuDecodeDone
evidence: waits for the IPU's block decode, running the decoder's callback of kind 1 while its input runs dry, refreshes the bit window and reports "Error code detected(BDEC)" and resets the IPU on an error

name: DecodeAllMacroblocks
evidence: decodes every macroblock of a picture (half of them for a field) with DecodeSliceMacroblocks, then adds the residuals, reporting "= Skip to the next picture =" on an error

name: DecodeSliceMacroblocks
evidence: decodes macroblocks up to a count, reading each slice's start and each macroblock's address increment, and returns 1 to 3 when it has to stop

name: SendIpuCommand
evidence: writes a command to the IPU's command register 0x10002000 and records what its kind leaves in the bit window (D_0027B040)

name: WaitIpuCommandDone
evidence: waits while the IPU is busy, running the stall callback every 5000 polls

name: DecodeIpuVariableLength
evidence: waits for the IPU, then sends it a variable-length decode command of a table and reads the decoded value

name: PeekIpuBits
evidence: returns the next n bits of the IPU's bit stream without consuming them

name: SkipIpuBits
evidence: sends the IPU a command that consumes n bits and refreshes the bit window

name: ReadIpuBits
evidence: returns the next n bits of the IPU's bit stream and consumes them

name: FindNextStartCode
evidence: aligns the IPU's bit stream to a byte and skips to the next start code prefix 0x000001

name: ParseMpegHeaders
evidence: reads start codes and their headers: a sequence header (0x1B3), a group of pictures (0x1B8), a picture (0x100), until the sequence's end (0x1B7)

name: ReadPictureHeader
evidence: reads a picture header: its temporal reference, coding type, delay and the forward and backward codes of P and B pictures

name: ReadExtensionsAndUserData
evidence: reads the extensions and user data after a header, dispatching each extension through the table D_00250430

name: ReadGroupOfPicturesHeader
evidence: reads a group of pictures header: its time code, closed and broken flags

name: DecodePictureData
evidence: picks the output picture by the picture structure (reporting "odd number of field pictures" or "unknown picture sutructure") and decodes its macroblocks with DecodeAllMacroblocks

name: ConvertPictureColours
evidence: converts a decoded picture's colours with the IPU by DMA, through interrupt handlers for large pictures
